idea-plugin.name: LionCPH
idea-plugin.description:
LionCPH brings the speed and workflow of VS Code's Competitive Programming Helper (CPH) natively to CLion.

  • Instant Compile & Judge: Parallel testcase execution, smart compile caching, signal diagnostics (SIGSEGV, Stack Overflow, TLE), and first-line diff hints.
  • Competitive Companion Integration: Automatically imports problems and sample testcases on ports 27121 & 10045.
  • Zero-Config CMake Auto-Sync: Automatically registers LionCPH-imported files in an isolated .cph/lioncph_targets.cmake and reloads CMake without touching user files.
  • Smart Codeforces Submit: Matches your CLion C++ standard to Codeforces languages with human pre-submit verification, working both with and without the cph-submit browser extension.
  • Custom Checker & ONLINE_JUDGE: Python Special Judge support and one-click ONLINE_JUDGE / LOCAL macro syncing.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 1.5.3: Fixed cph-submit idle polling (returns HTTP 404 when no submission is queued) to guarantee zero unintended browser tabs.
  • 1.5.2: Full resource & thread-pool hygiene, multi-window CLion support, Stop button for single-test runs, Gson upgrade safety, Codeforces EDU support, and hardened CMake GLOB detection.
  • 1.4.x: Pixel-faithful CPH UI, instant trash delete, isolated CMake auto-sync with reload, and dual-mode smart Codeforces Submit (with cph-submit IPv6/IPv4 support).

action.description: Compile and run all LionCPH testcases for the active C++ file
